structure: A short ruling file (48 lines), ruling-sam-2026-11-27.md, given while picking up the germinal products theme after the Design Release 2.1 prototype moved from commit 04a073b (5 October) to c2078fb (26 November). It holds a two-line verbatim quote from Sam, a sentence naming the seven open questions it answers (the 26 November report's questions whose rows include germinal products), nine numbered claims read from the quote (claims 1 to 7 keep the defaults for report questions 7, 9, 15, 20, 21, 28 and 35; claims 8 and 9 are new, on the animals dashboard and manage notifications themes), and one orchestrator's call flagged to Sam afterwards. The scope is the whole file, so nothing is left out. It is one part.

parts.title: Whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file: the context line, the verbatim quote, the note on which open questions it answers, the nine numbered claims and the orchestrator's call at the foot.
covers: The verbatim quote, checked against each listed claim: keep the defaults for the open questions; use what is already there for the animals dashboard; the manage notifications theme is in flight and may need catching up

Claims 1 to 7, each keeping the default for one report question: 7 (req-2135), 9 (req-2141), 15 (req-929), 20 (req-581, req-603, req-1625, req-1641), 21 (req-2217), 28 (req-594, req-611, req-2303) and 35 (req-1072), each with its question named in note
Claim 8 (new): the germinal products list, cards and delete message copy today's live animals list on main and do not wait for the animals dashboard theme

Claim 9 (new): germinal amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete build on the manage notifications theme; prototype changes since 5 October that reach manage notifications go to that theme's branch

The orchestrator's call: the animals dashboard theme's rows that reframe the live animals list carry the germinal list with them; it is the orchestrator's reading, not Sam's words, so it is inferred at most
Any point the ruling touches but leaves open, as a gap claim
